results.title: Kangana Ranaut fires back at Hrithik Roshan over viral apology trend: ‘Stop embarrassing your partner’
results.description: Kangana Ranaut has responded sharply to Hrithik Roshan after his remarks on the viral "We need to apologise to Hrithik" trend, urging him to stop encouraging online harassment against her. The actress also said that, being in a committed relationship with Saba Azad, it did not suit him to "tease a woman" publicly.
